original_card.question: Does one changed supplier or assembly claim lack a source-bound independent check of a specific new implication?
methods: Independently reconstruct a coordinated frame/circuit change and its single-change control, then derive the complete rank and physical ledger.
Implement certified moment inequalities through a different exact enclosure method.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Read #2979 joint rank-7 end-frame proposal and the revision-6 evidence status. Its claimed kappa is not selected. Compare coordinated changes with the losing single-change controls and locate the complete physical ledger; an aggregate moment alone does not validate the mechanism.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Prioritize a bounded independent audit of #2979: reconstruct one joint group and its single-lowering control, check the declared frames/chronology, then trace changed children, idle widths and cleanup buffers into the complete invoice and both supplier caps. Choose one still-missing implication after checking existing audits. Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Independent pricing prevents unsupported frontier claims and can reveal genuine accounting slack.
allowed_variations: Reconstruct either a source ledger or a numeric enclosure with a different method.
scope_change_triggers: Importing the primary function and calling its output independent verification.
Promoting #2979 from merged source archive to validated supplier solely from author PASS receipts or aggregate pricing.

actual_scope: For PR3576's complete T74 moment intervals over the PR2979 profile and order, independently check the exact inequality direction, strictness, and 30-place outward-rounding boundary with rational endpoint substitutions and corruption controls.
scope_change_reason: Live overlap showed open PR3576 already supplies the full T74 moment computation through two exact engines plus direct-rate and extra-rank-one controls. I narrowed the card to the nonduplicative acceptance boundary and did not reconstruct frames, repeat the invoice, or build another enclosure engine.
bottleneck_link: The T74 moment is the strict gate used to turn the complete paid profile into a layer-rate bound. An endpoint-direction or inward-rounding error could invalidate that local rate step.
stop_rule: Stop after exact rational checks of the three published intervals, both strict inequality directions, the stated sigma gap, and one-unit boundary/rounding canaries. Do not rederive the interval engines or extend into production payload and outer admission.
evidence: verify.py checks the exact PR3576 proof/rate source bytes, their Git blob IDs, the source-pinned PR2979 PROFILE/ORDER inputs, strict endpoint comparisons, the sigma margin, equality and straddling controls, and outward floor/ceiling behavior near one.
author: Cinna Davis
ai_assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with source discovery, exact-rational verifier implementation, and packaging.

open_questions.question: Does a future production T74 call path consume the same complete profile and strict moment contract that PR3576 certifies?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The endpoint audit confirms only the numerical acceptance boundary; source-to-production execution and the inherited physical and outer conditions remain separate.
open_questions.first_step: Trace the actual production entry point through the retuned constructor into the T74 call and bind its full profile to the pinned ORDER and PROFILE hashes.
open_questions.blocked_by: PR3576 records no full production GL64/T74 payload execution, and this session did not inspect or run that payload.
